data.name: Cool Effect Inc
data.description: Cool Effect is a US-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit carbon credit marketplace headquartered in Greenbrae, California. The platform curates and sells vetted carbon credits from third-party projects worldwide — including biochar, forest, soil carbon, cookstove, and renewable energy projects — to individuals and businesses seeking to offset emissions. It is an ecosystem player (retailer/marketplace), not a direct CDR supplier.
